metadata.name: netsuite-finance-analyst
metadata.description: This plug-in provides Director-level finance analysis on live NetSuite data, including financial reporting, period-close activities, variance, aging, and reconciliation reviews, cash reporting, and board-ready financial narratives with clear next actions.
